title: CIA and ODNI reportedly hit by intrusion into open-source analysis systems, per New York Times
date_note: The page gives only the report day (24 November, the New York Times report as relayed by EFE); the date of the intrusion is not stated.
org: CIA and Office of the Director of National Intelligence
geo_basis: agency country as the source states it; pin set at the capital
summary: The New York Times reported, citing US officials and people familiar with the incident, that the CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence detected a cyber intrusion that exposed unclassified information from open-source analysis systems. ODNI told the Times there were no interruptions to critical capabilities or classified systems. The CIA had not commented when Noticias Caracol relayed the report.
plain: The New York Times reports that hackers got into US intelligence systems holding unclassified, open-source material. ODNI told the paper classified systems were not disrupted.
exec: A reported intrusion at US intelligence agencies; ODNI says critical capabilities and classified systems were not disrupted. Details are from one relayed report.
impact: Unclassified information exposed, per the New York Times as relayed by Noticias Caracol.

validation.note: Two outlets read (Noticias Caracol and Sabah), both relaying the same New York Times report, so one origin; the NYT original was not read and the Arabic report (elwatannews.com) answered 403. ODNI statement only as quoted second-hand. The Pioneer (relaying AP, which cites the NYT report) read on 25 Nov: same origin, still not independent.

review.note: duplicate: same CIA/ODNI New York Times report as cia-odni-osint-network-breach-2026-11; duplicate_of set
